summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release updating progress on a €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 4–8 May 2026, the company repurchased 2,050,000 shares at an average price of €25.01 per share, for a total of €51.3 million. Cumulatively, 2,650,000 shares have been repurchased at an average price of €24.89, representing ~6.6% of the total programme value. The buyback aims to reduce share capital, with no specific timeline stated; watch for weekly updates and impact on EPS and capital ratios.
